title: Very Thin
text: Very Thin. I used this roll up mattress when we were at camp. The floor was cement, so this wasn't really the most comfortable. It was fine if you slept on your back or stomach. But if you're a side-sleeper (as I am) it is pretty miserable. I do find it more convenient than an air mattress (although it doesn't roll up to be very small). It was a decent size. On carpeted floor it is a little more comfortable, but definitely not something you're going to want to use for more than a night or two. A week on this was a bit brutal.
